race.title: Bowmer And Kirkland We Build As One Fighting Fifth Hurdle (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A good opportunity for ALEXEI to land a breakthrough Grade 1 success. Last year's winner of this race Golden Ace was held by Joe Tizzard's charge during the spring, and it could be improving Mydaddypaddy that gives the selection most to think about. ALEXEI (GER) MYDADDYPADDY (IRE) GOLDEN ACE
race.bettingForecast: Alexei (6/5), Mydaddypaddy (6/4), Golden Ace (11/2), Minella Study (16/1), Nemean Lion (25/1), Indemnity (66/1)
